limitations: Same-day breakouts across symbols are correlated, not independent trade samples; criteria 3 and 4 partially mitigate this limitation.
Long holdings in low-liquidity symbols face risk-tier and leverage constraints beyond tiered slippage; these are addressed in stage 2.
DESIGN pool only; this is a research gate, not holdout validation.
Independent one-unit trades; no portfolio, liquidation or capacity model.
Daily candles are aggregated from UTC hourly data.
D101 S1-B and the long-only variant were selected after prior DESIGN results.

rules.breakout: LONG close(B_0) > max(high(B_1..B_N)); SHORT close(B_0) < min(low(B_1..B_N)); strict comparison, signal day excluded.
rules.btc_state: Recorded at entry for technical reporting only; not an entry filter.
rules.daily: UTC daily bars are aggregated from exactly 24 complete 1h bars.
rules.delist: At E_a, close at close(L_a) * (1 - d * 0.02); this replaces D99 slippage.
rules.entry: At t UTC 00:00, use the 1h open with adverse D99 slippage.
rules.exit_time: Start timestamp of the exit 1h bar; delisting liquidation uses E_a.
rules.funding: Apply d * rate * 1h open for t < tau <= exit; delist tau=E_a uses close(L_a).
rules.future_path: Require complete hourly bars through the exit bar and funding gaps <= 8h.
rules.invalid: Stop at the first missing future point, omit R, and resume from the next t.
rules.liquidity: mean(D_1..D_30); D_j is the completed 24h window before B_0 per 04 3.3.
rules.risk: R0 = d * (close(B_0) - S0); R0 <= 0 is invalid.
rules.trail: At UTC 00:00, update from the last M closed daily bars; effective this 1h bar.
